entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: Machine learning, deep learning, neural networks and ML algorithms
Supervised and unsupervised learning with SciPy and ScikitLearn
Deploying machine learning algorithms and pipelines on Apache Spark
Deep learning models and neural networks with Keras, PyTorch and TensorFlow
Large language models and generative AI architectures
Natural language processing, including tokenization and embeddings
Transformer models, attention mechanisms and sequence to sequence models
Computer vision, image classification and convolutional neural networks
reading.format: Delivered as a 13 course series with hands-on labs and projects. Assessment is through practical project work and evaluations, including a portfolio-worthy project. Available in 19 languages.
reading.summary: This is a Professional Certificate made up of a 13 course series from IBM, offered on Coursera. It teaches learners to build, train and deploy machine learning and deep learning models, including large language models, using Python and common libraries. Completing it is presented as a way to show employers practical AI engineering skills and hands-on project experience.
reading.audience: The page says it is ideal for data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers and other technical specialists who want to become job ready as an AI engineer. It is listed at intermediate level with recommended experience.
reading.prerequisites: Listed at intermediate level with recommended experience.
